title: ModelLink
description: Provenance join for one logged model: which run, attempt and job produced it. MLflow holds the model.

project_id.title: ProjectId
project_id.description: Stable project identifier (lowercase slug). Never a path; paths live in the local registry.

model_id.title: LoggedModelId
model_id.description: MLflow 3 logged-model ID (`m-…`). Distinct from a run ID and a registry version.

experiment_id.title: MlflowExperimentId
experiment_id.description: MLflow experiment ID, as MLflow returns it.

source_run_id.title: MlflowRunId
source_run_id.description: MLflow run ID, as MLflow returns it.

ref.title: TrackingRunRef
ref.description: Tracked run (attempt or manual) that logged it.

attempt_id.title: AttemptId
attempt_id.description: Identifier of one attempt of a job.

model_key.description: SDK-side key of a model logged through `log_model` (idempotency).

origin.description: `sdk`: logged through the AblationKit SDK and collector. `discovered`: seen in MLflow (logged natively or imported).

created_at.title: Timestamp
created_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds.
